title: Parsing a protobuf SUMMARY metric that has no quantiles panics with an out-of-range slice index when Next() is called...

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #18382; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: Parsing a protobuf SUMMARY metric that has no quantiles panics with an out-of-range slice index when Next() is called without a preceding Series() call.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the textparse package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: getMagicLabel() indexes the summary quantile slice at p.fieldPos without bounds-checking, so a SUMMARY with no quantiles causes an out-of-range slice access and panic.

ops_fault.description: Scraping a protobuf SUMMARY with no quantile entries crashes the parser with an index-out-of-range panic.
repair_keywords: return early when no quantiles remain

visible_context.issue_text: Prometheus crashes while parsing a protobuf summary metric that has a sample_count and sample_sum but no quantiles; the parser hits an index-out-of-range panic mid-scrape.
error_logs: panic: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0
scrape failed: parser aborted on metric "no_quantile_summary"
visible_context.notes: Real upstream regression; diagnosis injected as upstream ops context.
